sloka: स निगृह्य तु तम् बाष्पम् प्रमृज्य नयने शुभे ।विनिःश्वस्य च तेजस्वी राघवम् पुनरूचिवान् ॥४-८-३१॥
transliteration: sa nigṛhya tu tam bāṣpam pramṛjya nayane śubhe ।viniḥśvasya ca tejasvī rāghavam punarūcivān ॥4-8-31॥

translations.english: Effulgent Sugriva controlled his tears, wiped his bright eyes, took deep breath and said to Rama:
